## Welcome to the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge!

Get ready to explore The Next Frontier! Register to join us on November 14-15.

Step 01

## CREATE ACCOUNT

August 26, 2026

The first step in your hackathon journey is to create a NASA Space Apps account or log in to your existing account.

Create Account

Step 02

## REGISTER FOR THE HACKATHON

August 26, 2026

To participate and be eligible for Global Judging, you must first register for the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge. You can register up until the hackathon closes on November 15.

Register

Step 03

## CHOOSE A LOCAL EVENT

August 26, 2026

Connect with the NASA Space Apps community by choosing an in-person or virtual Local Event near you. If you don’t have a Local Event near you, choose the virtual Universal Event. You can choose or change your event up until the hackathon closes on November 15.

Choose a Local Event

Step 04

## JOIN OR FORM A TEAM

September 17, 2026

Collaborate with participants by forming or joining a team according to your chosen challenge. Teams should have no more than six participants. You can choose or change your team up until the hackathon closes on November 15.

Browse Teams

Step 05

## SUBMIT A PROJECT

November 15, 2026

To edit and submit your project, go to the Project Tab on your Team’s page. Project submission opens on Saturday, November 14 at 9:00 AM and closes on Sunday, November 15 at 11:59 PM local time. Submit your project to receive a participant certificate and to be eligible for Global Judging. We encourage all participants to submit what they accomplish over the course of the hackathon.

Step 06

## Complete the Participant Survey

November 30, 2026

Share your feedback about your hackathon journey to help improve future events.

## 🇺🇸 ENGLISH VERSION

### NASA Space Apps Challenge Uberlândia 2026

November 14–15, 2026 · Uberlândia, Minas Gerais, Brazil · In-person event

Welcome to the official page of NASA Space Apps Challenge Uberlândia — the world's largest hackathon, running simultaneously in hundreds of cities and, here, in the heart of Brazil's Triângulo Mineiro region.

For 48 hours, students, developers, designers, scientists, entrepreneurs and curious minds come together to solve real challenges posed by NASA and its partner agencies, using open data about space and about our own planet. You don't need to be a scientist or work in tech — you just need to want to build something.

#### 🚀 Why join

  * Real challenges, real data. Work with open data from NASA and partner space agencies to tackle genuine problems — from climate to space exploration.
  * Global reach. The top teams from Uberlândia are nominated for global judging at the NASA Space Apps Challenge, competing with projects from around the world.

Saturday, November 14 Official opening, challenge briefing, team formation and validation, kickoff and mentoring rounds.

Sunday, November 15 Development continues, project submission on the official platform, pitches to the judging panel, awards and closing ceremony.

The detailed agenda will be published on our website and social media.

* * *

#### 📍 Venue

ESAMC Uberlândia — Avenue Vasconcelos Costa, 270 - Martins, Uberlândia - MG, 38400-448

Expected facilities: dedicated team workspaces, high-speed internet, rest areas, food service and mentoring rooms.

#### 👥 Who can take part

The NASA Space Apps Challenge is open to all ages! However, participants who are under the age of 18 must be registered for the event by a parent or legal guardian and must be accompanied by a parent or legal guardian at all times during the event, from any background. Teams have 1 to 6 members and can be formed before or during the event — we run a matchmaking session for those arriving solo.

Skills that make a difference on a team: programming, data and AI, design and UX, sciences (physics, astronomy, biology, meteorology), engineering, communication, business and storytelling.

### Welcome to NASA Space Apps Challenge Kothamangalam 2026!

Get ready to innovate, create, and solve real-world problems from the comfort of your workspace! This year, the Kothamangalam local event is going fully virtual, bringing the universe's largest annual global hackathon directly to your screens. Whether you are a coder, designer, storyteller, or space enthusiast, there is a place for your unique skills here.

### Why You Should Join

  * Tackle Global Challenges: Use open-source data from NASA and Space Agency Partners to build solutions with massive real-world impact.
  * Build Your Skills: Gain hands-on experience in software development, data science, hardware prototyping, and design.
  * Expand Your Network: Connect with local mentors, subject matter experts, and fellow innovators.
  * Win Awards: Compete for local recognition and the chance to be nominated as a Global Finalist on the world stage.

### How to Participate

  * Register: Click the sign-up button on this page to officially join our virtual Kothamangalam roster.
  * Form a Team: Join forces with 1 to 6 members. You can team up with friends or find new collaborators through our community channels.
  * Choose a Challenge: Review the official challenge summaries (releasing September 17) and pick your mission.
  * Check the Schedule: All official hackathon milestones, including our livestream kickoff and project submission deadlines, are listed on the "Local Event Schedule" tab.
  * Submit Your Project: Ensure your final project is submitted before November 15 at 11:59 PM local time.

### Get in Touch & Next Steps

Our local organizing team is here to support your journey from start to finish. Once you register, be sure to join our official Whatsapp community to receive real-time announcements, find teammates, and interact with our mentors.

## Welcome to NASA Space Apps Rome 2026

Join us in Rome, Italy, on 14-15 November 2026 for the NASA Space Apps Challenge - a global hackathon that brings together students, researchers, engineers, developers, scientists, designers, entrepreneurs, storytellers, and space enthusiasts to create innovative solutions to challenges on Earth and in space using NASA and partner open data.

### Who can participate?

Everyone is welcome. You do not need to be a space expert or an experienced programmer.

We especially encourage participation from people interested in:

  * Software development and programming
  * AeroSpace, Mechanical and Mechatronics engineering
  * Artificial Intelligence and Data Science
  * Engineering and Robotics
  * Earth Observation and Environmental Science
  * Space Science and Technology
  * Biomedical Engineering and Space Health
  * Design and UX/UI
  * Entrepreneurship and Innovation
  * Communication, Media, and Storytelling

Participants are encouraged to register early and follow the Rome Local Event page for important updates.

### Event information

📅 Dates: 14-15 November 2026
📍 Location: Rome, Italy
Participation fee: Free
Working language: English, with Italian support.

### Mentors and local community

Participants will have the opportunity to interact with mentors and experts from different fields, including science, engineering, technology, artificial intelligence, data analysis, design, innovation, and entrepreneurship.

### Before the event

We are planning additional activities to help participants prepare for the hackathon, including:

  * Welcome and orientation session
  * Team formation support
  * Challenge discovery
  * Open-data guidance
  * Mentoring
  * Pitch and project-submission preparation

### Stay connected

Follow NASA Space Apps Rome 2026 on our local social media channels for:

  * Registration updates

  * Team formation
  * Mentor and judge announcements
  * Workshops
  * Event schedule

BY PARTICIPATING IN THE NASA SPACE APPS CHALLENGE, THE PARTICIPANT (YOU) AGREES TO THE FOLLOWING TERMS AND CONDITIONS:

"Participant" or "you" means an individual who registers for the NASA Space Apps Challenge.

"NASA" or "Agency," as used herein, means the National Aeronautics and Space Administration, and includes its support contractors (at any tier) that are assisting NASA with the planning and execution of the NASA Space Apps Challenge.

PARTICIPATION
Participation in the NASA Space Apps Challenge (or "Space Apps," or "the event") or the Winners Celebration (a visit by global winners to a NASA Center or Facility for an award presentation) is fully voluntary, and participants are not entitled to compensation, nor will they be considered employees, agents, independent contractors, or consultants of NASA or of the United States (U.S.) Federal Government. Individuals who participate in the event shall engage in their personal capacity only, including identifying themselves by their own names. All U.S. Federal Government contractor employee participation shall be done on a voluntary basis outside of the participant’s working hours, and these participants shall not receive or be entitled to any compensation for the time that they spend preparing for or participating in the event. U.S. Federal Government civil servant employees are not eligible to register as Participants.

The NASA Space Apps Challenge will be held at each NASA Space Apps Challenge location starting on November 14, 2026 (or a different day during the same week previously expressly approved in writing by the NASA Space Apps Global Organizing Team). Prior to the start time, you must be registered to participate in the NASA Space Apps Challenge online at https://spaceappschallenge.org (a list of locations will be provided in August 2026).
